description: ResilientSC: who may look at, run and approve supply-chain response plans

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.View
scopes.description: Read simulations, plans, the network and operational metrics

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Operate
scopes.description: Create, run and reset simulations; send disruption signals from an integration flow

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Approve
scopes.description: Approve or reject a plan that compliance escalated to a human

role-templates.name: Operator
role-templates.description: Run scenarios and respond to disruptions

role-collections.name: ResilientSC Operator
role-collections.description: Run scenarios and respond to disruptions
